title.narrative: Capital Markets Development Trust Fund by AfDB (CMDTF) 2024-2026
Capital Markets Development Trust Fund by AfDB (CMDTF) 2024-2026

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the CMDTF is to promote the establishment of well-functioning capital markets in Africa that effectively mobilize and allocate resources to meet the financing needs of the private and public sectors. To achieve this goal, the CMDTF plans to:
i) Improve the regulatory and legal environment of capital markets;
(ii) upgrading the infrastructure of capital markets
(iii) diversify available products
(iv) broaden the investor base; and
v) Increase knowledge of African capital markets.
